milestones.label: Discounted application fee closes
milestones.note: Applying after this costs more. Not a barrier, and a needless cost.

milestones.label: Normal closing date
milestones.note: Early by European standards. Late applications reopen in March at a higher fee and cannot be used for every course.

milestones.label: Change of Mind opens
milestones.note: Free, and it lets you rewrite the list entirely — which is why the 1 February deadline is less frightening than it looks.

milestones.label: Change of Mind closes
milestones.note: The last chance to change what you are applying for, five days before IB results. The list you hold on this date is the list that is scored.

milestones.label: IB results released
milestones.note: After Change of Mind has closed. Which CAO offer round an IB applicant falls into is not established — ask CAO directly.

milestones.label: Round 1 offers
milestones.note: Follows Leaving Certificate results in late August. Later rounds fill courses that remain open.

notes: All dates carried from the published 2026-entry timetable and marked provisional.
